role: Preregistered contract for the v0.6.1 identifiability-first The Well shear_flow inverse. It recovers kappa, and reports nu, on the identifiable Reynolds 10000 subset chosen in docs/v061/identifiability.json. It holds no v0.6.1 test number. It does not edit v0.6 or earlier artifacts.
question: On the identifiable Reynolds 10000 subset of The Well shear_flow, with native 256 by 512 fields and the late_9 window, can a solver-free weak-form coefficient fit, a data-only FNO inverse on two probe lattices, and an FNO-bracket hybrid with split-conformal intervals recover kappa = 1/(Re Sc) from sparse noisy probes, against the frozen v0.6 bars plus a constant-predictor gate?

attribution.generator: Dedalus (Burns et al., Phys. Rev. Research 2, 023068, 2020)
attribution.access: huggingface_hub anonymous; no token. If rate-limited, back off and record the failure. Do not request credentials.

not_claimed: that a Dedalus or other PDE solver was run on these fields
identifiability of nu or kappa at Reynolds 50000 or higher
identifiability of kappa at Schmidt 5 or Schmidt 2 on the chosen window as an in-distribution cell
a retuned bar after seeing test scores
a change to any v0.6, v0.5.2, v0.5.1, v0.5, v0.4.1, or v0.4 number, protocol, or score file

aggregation.unit: one (nu, kappa) pair per instance per method per noise per density, then median relative error over the slice
aggregation.center: median over instances, then mean over seeds, then mean over the two densities
aggregation.coverage: fraction of test instances whose true nu and true kappa both lie in their split-conformal intervals at alpha 0.1
aggregation.reported_nu: nu is constant on the identifiable in-distribution slice and is reported, not the continuous inverse

pde.form: u_t + u·∇u + ∇p = nu Δu;  s_t + u·∇s = kappa Δs;  periodic;  mean(p) = 0

downsample.method: identity: the chosen setting is the native stored grid. No Fourier truncation.

time_window.name: late_9
time_window.note: Chosen on validation-only oracle cells in identifiability.json. Late window after the shear transient.

densities.name: 16x32
densities.layout: equispaced lattice, stride 16 on the native 256 by 512 grid

densities.name: 32x64
densities.layout: equispaced lattice, stride 8 on the native 256 by 512 grid

noise.model: additive iid Gaussian on observed field values, scaled by the clean-field standard deviation of that instance

subset.role: Named public files on the identifiable Reynolds 10000 slice. Raw HDF5 is never committed.

ood.reading: held-out Schmidt on the identifiable Reynolds

ood_re_reported_not_bar.reading: held-out Reynolds. The validation oracle missed the 0.02 gate, so this slice is reported and is not a pass bar.

from_train_files.assignment: by (file order, trajectory index) before any windowing: first 8 trajectories of each of the four train files are train (32). The next 16 trajectories of each file are calibration (64).

splits.from_valid_files: all official valid trajectories of the four in-distribution files are the FNO validation split
splits.from_test_files: all official test trajectories of the four in-distribution files are the in-distribution test split
splits.ood: official valid and test trajectories of Reynolds 10000, Schmidt 2. Those files are never used for training, calibration, or validation.
splits.ood_re: official valid and test trajectories of Reynolds 50000, Schmidt 1. Reported only. Not a pass bar.

wsindy.role: solver-free classical baseline: weak-form least-squares coefficient fit, not a support-discovery STLSQ

test_function.center_stride_rationale: Same stride fraction as the v0.5.2 fix, reused so the identifier is the repaired WSINDy.

wsindy.nu_equation: stacked ux and uy: ∫ (u_t + u·∇u + ∇p) φ = nu ∫ u Δφ
wsindy.kappa_equation: tracer: ∫ (s_t + u·∇s) φ = kappa ∫ s Δφ
wsindy.pressure: treated as a known probed field, not a library term

oracle.role: ceiling: the same weak-form fit on the clean full 256 by 512 field, no lattice, no noise

constant.role: training-set median of nu and of kappa. A method must have strictly lower in-distribution combined median rel than this predictor at noise 0.01 to count as passing.

fno_data.role: data-only FNO inverse on the probe lattice. The reused FNO2d class maps the noisy lattice (not a lift onto the native 256 by 512 grid) to a spatially pooled (log nu, log kappa). It is not a viscosity-conditioned rollout and not a Dedalus search.
fno_data.loss: mean squared error on (log nu, log kappa)
fno_data.checkpoint: lowest validation MSE on the official in-distribution valid split

hybrid.role: FNO-bracket + calibrated split-conformal intervals, adapted from v0.4.1 without a PDE solver. The data-only FNO locates a log-bracket. The WSINDy point is clipped into that bracket. Intervals are split-conformal on the calibration split of 64 instances.
hybrid.score: absolute error in log nu and in log kappa, separately
hybrid.coverage_definition: an instance is covered when true nu and true kappa both lie in their intervals

pysr.reason: PySR needs Julia. The skip is recorded here before scoring.

pass_bars.source: docs roadmap copied from v0.6, plus the constant-predictor gate. Not retuned.

nu_kappa_in_dist.name: in_dist_median_rel
nu_kappa_in_dist.statistic: median relative error of the hybrid, mean of the nu median and the kappa median, mean over seeds and densities, in-distribution test, noise 0.01

nu_kappa_ood.name: ood_median_rel
nu_kappa_ood.statistic: same statistic on the held-out Schmidt OOD slice, noise 0.01. The held-out Reynolds slice is not this bar.

gap.name: ood_over_in_dist
gap.statistic: ood_median_rel / max(in_dist_median_rel, 1e-12) of the hybrid at noise 0.01

coverage.name: interval_coverage
coverage.statistic: hybrid interval coverage on in-distribution test at noise 0.01, mean over seeds and densities

hybrid_beats.name: hybrid_beats_baselines_ood
hybrid_beats.statistic: hybrid ood_median_rel at noise 0.01 is strictly less than both wsindy and fno_data on that slice

noise_robustness.name: noise_5pct_not_worse_than_wsindy
noise_robustness.statistic: hybrid in-distribution median rel error at noise 0.05 is <= the wsindy value on the same slice

constant_predictor.name: beats_constant_predictor
constant_predictor.statistic: hybrid in-distribution median rel at noise 0.01 is strictly less than the training-median constant predictor on that slice

pass_bars.overall: pass only if every bar above passes

compute.ci: tiny synthetic fixture only. CI never downloads The Well and never trains the study.
